goal: Glide/Swipe type for English and German on the existing Alphabet layout; offline only. Preserve Cantonese tap-to-type, accented-character hold, spacebar trackpad and per-key haptics.

scope.lexiconSource: Installed OS text checker for completions; evaluate redistributable licensed word frequency dictionaries for full decoding
scope.withoutFullKeyboardAccess: Keyboard suggestion access should not rely on network; extension still needs app-group rights for preferences
outOfScope: Cantonese gesture romanization in first version

phases.name: Verify inputs and license
tasks: Inspect current key geometry and touch stack
Select and license an offline English/German word list and frequency data
Normalize capitalization, German umlauts, ß and compounds
Add tests that no word is uploaded
exitCriteria: No touch regression for tapped keys

phases.name: Capture gesture path
tasks: Replace per-key gesture recognizers with a shared row/keyboard interaction layer only after a trace test
Sample touch positions and timings while finger moves across keys
Map points to visible keys and neighboring hit zones, using actual layout frames
Disambiguate tap vs long-press diacritics (380ms) vs swipe vs Space cursor (150ms)
exitCriteria: Trace logs store no typed content by default
Continuous stroke across rows is captured
Normal keys and Space still work

phases.name: Decode English and German
tasks: Compress repeated key visits into candidate sequences
Use a compact trie/DAWG word dictionary in the extension bundle
Beam-search possible candidates with geometric distance, transposition and language-model frequency
German compounds and accented spellings get explicit tests
Use preferred-language ordering, switch the active candidate set automatically without a mode key
exitCriteria: Top-3 stroke accuracy measured on labeled test cases

phases.name: Compose and commit
tasks: Show top three predicted words in the shared iOS-style prediction strip
Commit only on explicit completion of the stroke
Allow quick correction by tapping another candidate
Verify source word immediately before host cursor before replacement
Learn selection counts per language on device
exitCriteria: No unintended replacement when cursor moves
Cantonese candidates and literal Latin input preserved

phases.name: Physical-device performance
tasks: Compare iPhone 17 Pro Max swipe test against iOS QuickPath or SwiftKey behavior on the same sentence corpus
Check haptic cadence and visible key highlight
Use Keychain/App Group only for authorized preferences; no network or analytics
Measure and cap decode CPU/memory/time in keyboard extension
exitCriteria: Explicit user acceptance before enabling by default

risks.issue: SwiftUI per-key DragGesture already consumes touch sequences
risks.mitigation: Refactor interaction at a single keyboard surface; do not layer a competing global pan on top.

risks.issue: Language models are not part of UITextChecker's public APIs
risks.mitigation: Bundle a licensed offline corpus and decode paths; UITextChecker remains for tap spelling suggestions only.

risks.issue: User has Cantonese and Latin active simultaneously
risks.mitigation: Keep phonetic IME choice and glide decoder separated by gesture type; avoid toggling language.

risks.issue: German compounds and umlaut variants increase search space
risks.mitigation: Language-specific morphology and test corpus, strict memory budget.

risks.issue: Native Apple's touch-area adaptation is proprietary
risks.mitigation: Approximate hit zones from geometry and optimize with physical tests; never claim identical internal algorithms.

nextDecision: Implement a gesture-trace prototype behind a disabled-by-default feature flag, after the current IPA is verified on the user's iPhone.
